The '''Jedi utility belt''' was a type of [[Utility belt/Legends|utility belt]] made available by the [[Jedi Temple quartermaster]] to members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] between the [[New Sith Wars]] and the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They usually consisted of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], which was traditionally worn on the left, survival rations in the form of capsules, a [[Hush-98 comlink/Legends|Hush-98]] [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], a [[Fibercord/Legends|fibercord]] [[Grappling hook/Legends|grappling hook]] and/or a [[Liquid-cable launcher/Legends|grappling spike launcher]], a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]], such as an [[Imagecaster/Legends|Imagecaster]], a [[Holomap/Legends|holomap]], an [[A99 aquata breather/Legends|A99 aquata breather]], a [[Jedi beacon transceiver]], a [[Glowrod/Legends|glowrod]], and lightsaber repair tools. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] wore a dark-[[Color/Legends|colored]] Jedi utility belt in the [[Standard day/Legends|days]] leading up to his transformation into the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] Darth Vader. Other mission-specific equipment may be added, as assigned by the High Council or Jedi quartermaster.
